sentences.en: The body of a recruit has been exhumed for a second post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 这名新兵的遗体被重新挖掘出来进行了第二次验尸。

sentences.en: The post-mortem revealed that the cause of death was a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 验尸结果显示死亡原因是心脏病发作。

sentences.en: After the accident, they decided to conduct a thorough post-mortem investigation.
sentences.zh: 事故发生后，他们决定进行彻底的验尸调查。

senses.zh: 验尸的,死后的,事后的n.验尸,尸体解剖,事后的调查分析
